subject.title: Migration-import config merge has no prototype-pollution guard, unlike the sibling config-path writer

question: Should migration config patch helpers reject affected items or silently drop `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` keys when imported config contains them?
rationale: The primitive is clear, but the exact failure mode becomes a security and compatibility contract for bundled and third-party migration providers.

options.title: Guard the SDK helper
options.body: Block prototype-bearing keys in `mergeMigrationConfigValue` and path creation, with focused tests for direct helper and Hermes-imported provider/MCP/skill keys.

options.title: Sanitize provider imports only
options.body: Filter unsafe names in Hermes and sibling migration providers, leaving the shared helper contract unchanged but less comprehensively protected.

options.title: Accept trusted-import risk
options.body: Document migration imports as trusted input and leave the current primitive in place.

recommendation.title: Guard the SDK helper
recommendation.body: Block prototype-bearing keys in `mergeMigrationConfigValue` and path creation, with focused tests for direct helper and Hermes-imported provider/MCP/skill keys.

likelyOwner.reason: The earliest migration-provider and onboarding-flow commits in the live PR metadata are by steipete, making him the best available owner for the SDK-helper contract choice.
